function.name: lookup_customer
function.description: Look up the caller's Summit Air account. Call this early in every call. Omit phone to use the caller ID; pass phone only if the caller gives a different number on their account. Returns found, first_name, membership, addresses on file (street, unit, ZIP) and an equipment summary.

phone.description: Phone number on the account, any US format (e.g. 718-555-0101). Leave out to use the caller's number.

messages.content: Thanks for your patience, still pulling that up.
